run_algotune_benchmark: run all algotune tasks sequentially and measure speedup achieved by openevolve
run_specific_algotune_tasks: run specific algotune tasks by name with custom iterations and timeout settings
discover_algotune_tasks: discover all algotune task directories that contain required initial program, evaluator, and config files
parse_openevolve_results: parse openevolve output directory and extract best program info, speedup scores, and evaluation results
calculate_algotune_score: calculate the algotune score as the harmonic mean of speedup values across all tasks
